long_description:
The North Texas Hindu Mandir is honored to welcome Arun Gossai of the Bhuvaneshwar Mandir (New York City) for a special three‑day Sharad Navratri observance, taking place Friday through Sunday, October 9–11, 2026.

This auspicious weekend will be observed during Sharad Navratri 2026, a sacred period dedicated to the worship of the Divine Mother in her various forms. Devotees are invited to participate in traditional Navratri services led by Pt. Mahendra Persad.

Sharad Navratri is a time of reflection, devotion, and renewal, and this program offers the community a meaningful opportunity to come together in prayer and celebration during this sacred season.

Further details regarding the daily schedule and services will be shared closer to the event.
